definitions.explanation: The leader or captain of a sports team, or historically the chief commander of an army. In modern usage, most commonly refers to a team captain in sports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主将|しゅしょう}だ。
{主将|しゅしょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{選手宣誓|せんしゅせんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: As captain, I gave the athletes' oath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{主将|しゅしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She was chosen as the new captain because she has the ability to bring the team together.

notes:
USAGE:
{主将|しゅしょう} is used in sports contexts for the team captain, the player who leads the team and often serves as the representative in ceremonies. In baseball, the {主将|しゅしょう} is distinct from the ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ (manager). In historical contexts, it refers to the supreme commander of an army.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧ (captain) is the loanword equivalent used more casually. ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧{主将|しゅしょう} is the vice-captain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主将|しゅしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as captain)
- {主将|しゅしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ (to be chosen as captain)
- ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧{主将|しゅしょう} (vice-captain)
- {選手宣誓|せんしゅせんせい} (athletes' oath — often given by the captain)
